TEAMS_INSTRUCTIONS.TITLE: Install bot on Microsoft Teams
TEAMS_INSTRUCTIONS.SUB_TITLE: Follow the steps below to add the bot to your workspace.

STEP_1.TITLE: Download the bot package
STEP_1.INFO: Click the button below to download the bot .zip file to your computer.

STEP_3.TITLE: Go to Apps
STEP_3.INFO: In the left sidebar menu, click Apps.

STEP_4.TITLE: Upload a custom app
STEP_4.INFO_1: In the lower left corner, click Manage your apps.
STEP_4.INFO_2: Choose "Upload an app" at the top of the page.

STEP_5.TITLE: Upload the bot .zip package
STEP_5.INFO: Choose "Upload a custom app" and select the bot package you just downloaded.

STEP_6.TITLE: Complete the installation
STEP_6.INFO: After the upload, follow Teams instructions to finish installing the bot in your environment.

STEP_7.TITLE: Activate the integration
STEP_7.INFO: Activate the integration by toggling the switch in the integrations list.
